test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The magnetic field lines produced by a bar magnet ________.

options.text: originate from its north pole and end at its east pole
originate from its south pole and end at its east pole
originate from its south pole and end at its north pole
originate from its north pole and end at its south pole

solution:
The correct answer is **__originate from its north pole and end at its south pole__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **Magnetic field lines are imaginary lines.** Magnetic field lines are a visual tool used to represent magnetic fields. They describe the direction of the magnetic force on a north monopaole at any given position. The density of the lines indicates the magnitude of the field.
